title: Navigating Hybrid Governance Systems in Crisis Settings
discussion_signal: The post describes civil society, traditional leaders, private actors, and armed groups operating alongside or in place of state actors, and frames service delivery as an ethical and political-economy problem. It supports a state-legitimacy reading in which access can depend on negotiated hybrid arrangements rather than formal institutions alone.
linked_research_question: When non-state actors deliver or mediate services, how do people weigh access, legitimacy, accountability, and risk?
